item.tib: mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig sde lnga las las tshogs rin chen gter phreng
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang gnas chen brag dkar yang rtse'i mdun gter sgrom shel gyi pha wong nas chu mo glang gi lo hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes 16 gi nyi shar la 'gru btsun 7tshe dbang grags pas ye shes mkha' 'gro'i grogs dang bcas te dngos grub rnyed nas phyis shing pho stag gi lor hor zla'i 9u0f8b tshes 4 la lung zin grogs mchog drung mu wer zhi'i (zhis) bskul ba'i rten 'brel legs par byung nas/ mkha' 'gro'i brda ris shog bu las bod yig tu thar bde smin grol gling gi lha khang byin brlabs (rlabs) dngos 'bebs su phabs te/ yi ge pa ni drung mu wer zhis bgyis pas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung zhing / phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas nas nub med yun du gnas par gyur cig/
